_about: Round 2 (2026-11-25). What 'python tune.py' tries. A variant changes ONE setting ('setting' + 'value'), or several together ('settings'). 'videos' empty means every video in test_videos/. Round 1 is in variants_round1.json.

variants.label: Closer look, exact moments
variants.why: Claude studies up to 6 frames per shot instead of 1, and adds an extra effect at each exact moment it spots, like a grab or a snap.

variants.label: Best of three effects
variants.why: Makes three versions of every effects clip and keeps the one that best matches the description.

variants.label: Room echo on effects
variants.why: Adds a little echo sized to the room in the picture, so effects sit in the space instead of sounding dry.

variants.label: Music dips under loud effects
variants.why: The music drops back for a moment whenever the effects get loud, then comes back.

variants.label: All four together
variants.why: Closer planning, best of three, room echo and music dipping, all at once.
